name: Written Comprehension
desc: The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.

name: Deductive Reasoning
desc: The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.

name: Memorization
desc: The ability to remember information such as words, numbers, pictures, and procedures.

name: Selective Attention
desc: The ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time without being distracted.

name: Multilimb Coordination
desc: The ability to coordinate two or more limbs (for example, two arms, two legs, or one leg and one arm) while sitting, standing, or lying down. It does not involve performing the activities while the whole body is in motion.

name: Static Strength
desc: The ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull, or carry objects.

name: Dynamic Flexibility
desc: The ability to quickly and repeatedly bend, stretch, twist, or reach out with your body, arms, and/or legs.

name: Night Vision
desc: The ability to see under low-light conditions.

name: Sound Localization
desc: The ability to tell the direction from which a sound originated.

name: Social
desc: Work involves helping, teaching, advising, assisting, or providing service to others. Social occupations are often associated with social, health care, personal service, teaching/education, or religious activities.

name: Required Level of Education
desc: The level of education required to perform a job.

name: Mathematics
desc: Using mathematics to solve problems.

name: Administration and Management
desc: Knowledge of business and management principles involved in strategic planning, resource allocation, human resources modeling, leadership technique, production methods, and coordination of people and resources.

name: Transportation
desc: Knowledge of principles and methods for moving people or goods by air, rail, sea, or road, including the relative costs and benefits.

name: Building and Construction
desc: Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in the construction or repair of houses, buildings, or other structures such as highways and roads.

name: Psychology
desc: Knowledge of human behavior and performance; individual differences in ability, personality, and interests; learning and motivation; psychological research methods; and the assessment and treatment of behavioral and affective disorders.

name: English Language
desc: Knowledge of the structure and content of the English language including the meaning and spelling of words, and rules of composition and grammar.

name: Law and Government
desc: Knowledge of laws, legal codes, court procedures, precedents, government regulations, executive orders, agency rules, and the democratic political process.

name: Personal Service
desc: Work involves providing personal services to individuals in need of non-medical assistance such as helping arrange or plan for travel, meals, or events.

name: Accounting
desc: Work involves examining, analyzing, and interpreting accounting records for financial statements, or maintaining, auditing, or evaluating records and accounts.

name: Law
desc: Work involves studying and applying legal knowledge.

name: Nature/Outdoors
desc: Work involves planning, restoring, and conserving natural areas and wildlife habitats.

name: Medical Science
desc: Work involves studying and researching the causes, nature, effects, and treatments of disease or other forms of impairment or illness.

name: Applied Arts and Design
desc: Work involves applying artistic principles to the design and creation of various objects and materials.

name: Teaching/Education
desc: Work involves teaching through lectures, discussions, and demonstrations in one or more subjects.

name: Social Perceptiveness
desc: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

name: Complex Problem Solving
desc: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

name: Operations Monitoring
desc: Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.

name: Judgment and Decision Making
desc: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

name: Management of Personnel Resources
desc: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.

name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People
desc: Assessing the value, importance, or quality of things or people.

name: Updating and Using Relevant Knowledge
desc: Keeping up-to-date technically and applying new knowledge to your job.

name: Controlling Machines and Processes
desc: Using either control mechanisms or direct physical activity to operate machines or processes (not including computers or vehicles).

name: Documenting/Recording Information
desc: Entering, transcribing, recording, storing, or maintaining information in written or electronic/magnetic form.

name: Selling or Influencing Others
desc: Convincing others to buy merchandise/goods or to otherwise change their minds or actions.

name: Guiding, Directing, and Motivating Subordinates
desc: Providing guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

name: Public Speaking
desc: How frequently does your job require public speaking (one speaker with an audience)?

name: Work With or Contribute to a Work Group or Team
desc: How important is it to work with or contribute to a work group or team in this job?

name: Dealing With Unpleasant, Angry, or Discourteous People
desc: How frequently does the worker have to deal with unpleasant, angry, or discourteous individuals as part of the job requirements?

name: In an Open Vehicle or Operating Equipment
desc: How often does this job require working in an open vehicle or operating equipment (like a tractor)?

name: Exposed to Contaminants
desc: How often does this job require working exposed to contaminants (such as pollutants, gases, dust or odors)?

name: Exposed to Hazardous Conditions
desc: How often does this job require exposure to hazardous conditions?

name: Spend Time Walking or Running
desc: How much does this job require walking or running?

name: Wear Common Protective or Safety Equipment such as Safety Shoes, Glasses, Gloves, Hearing Protection, Hard Hats, or Life Jackets
desc: How often does this job require wearing common protective or safety equipment such as safety shoes, glasses, gloves, hearing protection, hard hats or life-jackets?

name: Degree of Automation
desc: How automated is the job?

name: Pace Determined by Speed of Equipment
desc: How important is it to this job that the pace is determined by the speed of equipment or machinery? (This does not refer to keeping busy at all times on this job.)

name: Tolerance for Ambiguity
desc: A tendency to be comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty at work.

name: Humility
desc: A tendency to be modest and humble when interacting with others at work.

name: Cautiousness
desc: A tendency to be careful, deliberate, and risk-avoidant when making work-related decisions or doing work.
